item.title: Odessa A’zion Exits Sean Durkin’s ‘Deep Cuts’ After Casting Backlash: “I Hadn’t Read The Book”
item.description: Well, that was fast. THR reports that just days after being cast in Sean Durkin‘s “Deep Cuts,” actress Odessa A’zion will exit the A24 film due to backlash over her casting. The controversy stems from the character A’zion signed on to play: Zoe Gutierrez, a character in Holly Brickley’s 2023 novel who is half Mexican and half Jewish. A’zion, while Jewish, isn’t Mexican, prompting allegations of whitewashing online. Continue reading Odessa A’zion Exits Sean Durkin’s ‘Deep Cuts’ After Casting Back
